egress.terms: The free download limit is only tracked per *IP address*. This means that if you are sharing an IP address with other people, like through a VPN, company network or a CGNAT network then the download limit is also shared. For free downloads it makes no difference if you’re logged in to an account or not.

tooling: Full REST API at /api with HTTP Basic (api key as password). rclone has no official backend; the API is simple enough that wrappers abound (Atlas electron/downloads/hosts/pixeldrain.js). PUT https://pixeldrain.com/api/file/ with -u :APIKEY.

limits_note: Free uploads require an API key (anonymous server-side PUT returned 401 authentication_required). 6 GB/day/IP download cap; 1 MiB/s throttle and 3 concurrent downloads after that. Files expire 60 days after last download; a download only counts if >10% of the file was transferred in one request, and the timer only updates once per 24h. Hotlinking not supported on free.

extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: Free plan: storage 'No limit' for regular uploads (2 TB limit only on the paid filesystem product). Pro: no limit; Prepaid: EUR 4/TB/month metered.
extras.limits_verbatim: Free uploads require an API key (anonymous server-side PUT returned 401 authentication_required). 6 GB/day/IP download cap; 1 MiB/s throttle and 3 concurrent downloads after that. Files expire 60 days after last download; a download only counts if >10% of the file was transferred in one request, and the timer only updates once per 24h. Hotlinking not supported on free.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free egress capped at 6 GB/day per IP address (sliding 24h window, IP-bound even when logged in); over the cap the speed drops to 1 MiB/s and max 3 concurrent downloads. Pro: 4 TB per 30 days. Prepaid: EUR 1/TB metered. So free egress is metered, not unusable — 6 GB/day x N IPs.
extras.chaining_verbatim: API keys are free and per-account, but the real multiplier is IP: the 6 GB/day download cap is per IP, so egress scales with egress IPs (proxies/CF Workers) not accounts. Storage itself is 'No limit' on free, which is the interesting half.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Full REST API at /api with HTTP Basic (api key as password). rclone has no official backend; the API is simple enough that wrappers abound (Atlas electron/downloads/hosts/pixeldrain.js). PUT https://pixeldrain.com/api/file/ with -u :APIKEY.
extras.agent_focus: big anonymous file hosts, with mandatory Buzzheavier deep dive on its published free-tier-stacking architecture

binding_note: a clock, not a quota: bytes leave whether or not transfer is completed
